I am too old to be carrying heavy bags of chemical fertilizer from the market, and my small plot of yam and cassava has always fed us well with the soil God provided. The rains here in the South East come twice a year and are plenty for my crops, so I do not need to water them. My children and grandchildren help me with the planting, weeding, and harvesting when they have time, but the land is small enough that we do not need to hire outside workers.
